pr_metadata.title: raylib: cleanup experimental mode gradient color calculations

gold_comments.issue_summary:
The removal of the rounding operation `int(path_hue * 100 + 0.5) / 100` may change the precision of the hue calculation. Consider whether this precision loss was intentional for performance or visual consistency reasons.
```suggestion
      path_hue = int(np.clip(60 + self._acceleration_x[i] * 35, 0, 120) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
```
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added line `path_hue = np.clip(60 + self._acceleration_x[i] * 35, 0, 120)` must be cited to show removal of prior rounding.
gold_comments.rationale: Removing the rounding may cause subtle visual inconsistencies in gradient color transitions due to increased floating-point precision in hue values.
